# Lipgloss Organizer

This is a parametric 3D model for a lipgloss organizer specifically designed with 50-degree tilted slots for easy access and display.

<img src="render.png" width="400" />

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
